sloka: पालय अस्मान् महाबाहो गिरिम् उद्धर्तुम् अर्हसि ।इति श्रुत्वा हृषीकेशः कामठम् रूपम् आस्थितः ॥१-४५-२९॥
transliteration: pālaya asmān mahābāho girim uddhartum arhasi ।iti śrutvā hṛṣīkeśaḥ kāmaṭham rūpam āsthitaḥ ॥1-45-29॥

translations.english: Having heard these words, the controller of the sense organs, Visnu, assumed the form of a tortoise reclined in the ocean supporting the mountain on its back.
